title: Toy Brawl
tagline: Two to four players, one tiny arena.
description: The example game that ships with netplay-kit: run, jump and bump into each other, with rollback netcode keeping every screen in step.
steps: Download and open the game, then choose Online.
Pick a room from the list below, or create your own.
Take a seat and press Ready. The match starts when everyone is ready.
Rooms are free: bring friends by sharing the lobby address shown on this page.
